title: DBDSVDMR3: An MRRR-Based Bidiagonal SVD Solver Built from DSTEGR
summary: The optimal algorithm for the symmetric tridiagonal eigenvalue problem is Multiple Relatively Robust Representations (MRRR or MR$^3$), which is capable of computing $k$ eigenvalue/eigenvector pairs in only $O(kn)$ floating-point operations. While MRRR is nearly 30 years old, it has never successfully been adapted to the bidiagonal SVD. This is not for lack of trying; two previous attempts produced implementations that were considered for LAPACK but eventually abandoned, a result of the fact that neither was reliable enough when run on test problems.
